prompt.name: Horseman
prompt.look: A classical light cavalryman on a dapple-grey horse with a dark grey mane and tail and white socks. The rider has a short brown beard, a bronze open-faced helmet, a short-sleeved tunic and brown leather boots, and carries a long javelin. The horse wears a saddle cloth under a brown leather saddle and a brown bridle.
prompt.team_area: the rider's tunic and the saddle cloth
prompt.coat: The horse is dapple-grey with a dark grey mane and tail: no chestnut, bay or orange-brown anywhere on it.
prompt.identity: the same rider, helmet, beard, red tunic and javelin, and the same dapple-grey horse, saddle, red saddle cloth and bridle
prompt.weapon_pose: He holds the javelin upright in his right hand, its butt end above the horse's belly.
prompt.attack: (1) ready, javelin upright; (2) he raises the javelin to his shoulder, pointing right; (3) wind-up: arm drawn far back, body twisting; (4) the thrust: arm and javelin driving forward and down to the right; (5) full extension, the javelin still in his hand; (6) recover to ready.
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a broken javelin shaft and a torn bridle
